priorityList: Keep Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield active at all times.
Cast Primordial Storm if you have 9+ Maelstrom Weapon stacks or if the buff is expiring soon (with at least 5 stacks).
Maintain Flame Shock on your target using Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock.
Cast Sundering if Surging Elements or Feral Spirit is talented.
Cast Crash Lightning if its buff is not active or if Storm Unleashed is talented.
Cast Windstrike if you have any Maelstrom Weapon stacks (requires Thorim's Invocation).
Use Stormstrike or Crash Lightning during Doom Winds to trigger Thorim's Invocation.
Cast Tempest when at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Lightning Bolt when at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Stormstrike if you are about to reach maximum charges (1.8+ charges).
Cast Stormstrike as a primary filler.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 8 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
